import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAXN = 500;
    
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
        Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }
    
    static boolean[][] m = new boolean[11][11];
    static List<Integer>[] g = new List[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] d = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAXN];
    static int n, t, temp[][] = new int[11][11], kaps[][] = new int[11][11];
    static int xb, yb;
    
    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<int[]> l = new LinkedList<>();
        l.offer(new int[]{0, x1, y1});
        int[][] h = new int[11][11];
        for (int p = 0; p < 11; p++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 11; b++) {
                h[p][b] = INF;
            }
        }
        while (!l.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = l.poll();
            int v = cur[0], x = cur[1], y = cur[2];
            h[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && m[x-1][y] && h[x-1][y] > h[x][y] + 1 && 
                ((x-1 == x2 && y == y2 && temp[x-1][y] >= h[x][y] + 1) || 
                 !(x-1 == x2 && y == y2) && temp[x-1][y] > h[x][y] + 1)) {
                l.offer(new int[]{v+1, x-1, y});
            }
            if (y > 0 && m[x][y-1] && h[x][y-1] > h[x][y] + 1 && 
                ((x == x2 && y-1 == y2 && temp[x][y-1] >= h[x][y] + 1) || 
                 !(x == x2 && y-1 == y2) && temp[x][y-1] > h[x][y] + 1)) {
                l.offer(new int[]{v+1, x, y-1});
            }
            if (x < n-1 && m[x+1][y] && h[x+1][y] > h[x][y] + 1 && 
                ((x+1 == x2 && y == y2 && temp[x+1][y] >= h[x][y] + 1) || 
                 !(x+1 == x2 && y == y2) && temp[x+1][y] > h[x][y] + 1)) {
                l.offer(new int[]{v+1, x+1, y});
            }
            if (y < n-1 && m[x][y+1] && h[x][y+1] > h[x][y] + 1 && 
                ((x == x2 && y+1 == y2 && temp[x][y+1] >= h[x][y] + 1) || 
                 !(x == x2 && y+1 == y2) && temp[x][y+1] > h[x][y] + 1)) {
                l.offer(new int[]{v+1, x, y+1});
            }
        }
        return h[x2][y2];
    }
    
    static void add_edge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
        Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
        g[a].add(e.size());
        e.add(e1);
        g[b].add(e.size());
        e.add(e2);
    }
    
    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(0);
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && d[n*n*2+1] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int j : g[v]) {
                int to = e.get(j).b;
                if (d[to] == -1 && e.get(j).flow < e.get(j).cap) {
                    q.offer(to);
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[n*n*2+1] != -1;
    }
    
    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == n*n*2+1) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (d[to] != d[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed != 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        for (;;) {
            if (!bfs()) break;
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(0, INF);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        Queue<int[]> l = new LinkedList<>();
        char x;
        int k = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                x = sc.next().charAt(0);
                temp[i][j] = t;
                if (x == 'Z') {
                    xb = i;
                    yb = j;
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else if (x == 'Y') {
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    m[i][j] = true;
                }
                add_edge(0, k++, (x == 'Z' || x == 'Y') ? 0 : x - 48);
            }
        }
        k = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                x = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (x >= '0' && x <= '9') {
                    kaps[i][j] = x - 48;
                }
                add_edge(k++, n * n * 2 + 1, (x == 'Z' || x == 'Y') ? 0 : x - 48);
            }
        }
        l.offer(new int[]{0, xb, yb});
        while (!l.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = l.poll();
            int v = cur[0], x = cur[1], y = cur[2];
            temp[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x-1][y] && m[x-1][y]) {
                l.offer(new int[]{v+1, x-1, y});
            }
            if (y > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x][y-1] && m[x][y-1]) {
                l.offer(new int[]{v+1, x, y-1});
            }
            if (x < n-1 && v + 1 < temp[x+1][y] && m[x+1][y]) {
                l.offer(new int[]{v+1, x+1, y});
            }
            if (y < n-1 && v + 1 < temp[x][y+1] && m[x][y+1]) {
                l.offer(new int[]{v+1, x, y+1});
            }
        }
        k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int k1 = n * n;
                k++;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; w++) {
                        k1++;
                        if (m[i][j] && m[z][w] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t) {
                            add_edge(k, k1, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
